pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed for students who are preparing for a presentation, pitch or public speaking opportunity.  You will be able to deliver your presentations confidently after this session.

I help students prepare for presentations of any kind by helping them prepare their material in a clear and concise way and deliver the presentation with confidence. I have helped people in many different situations, from founders pitching to VC's to business executives presenting to their boards. 

We'll review your material and practice going through the presentation to improve everything from the introduction to the conclusion of your pitch and work on key phrases that can help you get your message across to your audience easily.  If you need help with your presentation, this is the class for you.

pro_course_detail.title: 🎙️🗣️Conversational English Practice & Business English Practice 👩‍💼💼👨‍💼
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is perfect for students who want to improve their conversational skills.  Whether you want to get more comfortable introducing yourself or speaking with colleagues, you will be able to speak with confidence and avoid misunderstandings after taking this class

Topics can include recent news and world events as well as business discussions about the latest trends in economics, technology or global politics.  

This lesson is best for students with at least a basic understanding of the English language who are able to express themselves.  Conversational practice is a great way to sound more like a native speaker, avoid misunderstandings and portray a professional attitude in business conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation and Coaching 💪💪💪
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are designed for students who are looking to interview with an English-speaking company.  You will be prepared to answer all types of interview questions after this session.

This is a great chance to do a practice interview with a native English speaker with management and hiring experience and get feedback before you interview with a company.

I'll start by reviewing your CV and the job description of the company you are applying for.
Then, I will ask you a few questions about the company and the specific role you are applying for.  Then we'll discuss potential interview questions based on your industry and role.  I'll work with you to ensure you have strong answers as well as examples from your past experience to help you answer the most common interview questions.  

I'll make sure that you're comfortable explaining your answers in English and that you are delivering them in a clear and concise manner.

I'll also coach you on proper interviewing etiquette, including before, during and after the interview. My goal is to make sure you feel comfortable and confident before your interview.  

I was a hiring manager for three years and have interviewed hundreds of potential candidates in the past, so I know what types of questions companies and hiring managers like to ask and how to best answer these questions.

We can also discuss salary negotiations and job expectations.

You will feel more confident and prepared for your interview after this session.

pro_course_detail.title: 🚨Last Minute Interview Preparation🚨
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you have an interview in the next few days or even the next few hours?  This class will help you get ready for your interview in as little as one hour.

This class is designed specifically to help you prepare for an interview in a short amount of time.  We will discuss the most common interview questions and make sure you can talk about your work experience clearly.

I'll review your CV and the job description of the position you're applying for to give you an idea of what types of questions the hiring manager is most likely to ask.

pro_course_detail.title: Resume/CV Review, Editing or Creation 🧐📄✍️
pro_course_detail.description:
This is class is specifically for resume/CV review, editing or creation.  You will have a better resume and/or cover letter after this session.

Resumes should be tailor made to showcase your best skills and accomplishments related to specific jobs you are applying for.

If you already have a resume, we can review the resume today and I will provide recommendations on how to improve your writing to create a more effective resume.   

If you don't have a resume yet, we'll discuss your academic and professional career and create a standout resume together.  (Please note, creating a resume from scratch may take more than one class.)

I have helped dozens of people improve their resumes to improve their effectiveness and increase the likelihood of getting an interview.

teacher_info.intro:
Remember your overseas vacation in 1993?

At an amusement park by the sea, you met Barney, a local
resident who had been studying English his entire life.

And yet, when you asked him what his favorite animal was,
he froze. He stammered. He looked up at some trees.

Now why was that?

Indeed, hardly anyone there could speak any English at all.

The next day you went on a train ride. In your compartment
were three backpackers from places you couldn’t pronounce.

Still, they talked to you about camping ... cactus … discos ...
pyramids...fleas...watermelons...bungee jumping...telepathy
UFOs…ponds...off-the-wall jokes . . . all in proper English.

So what was their secret?

Hmmm. Good question.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
"Hello! Where's the Lake Town?" Bray asked an 81-year-old
tending some cows. She gave him a puzzled look. "Gee, nobody 
here speaks English," he thought. 

And although Bray had studied the local language at school for
nine years, he had pretty much forgotten everything.

So he kept pedaling along, trying to figure out how to get to the
town, and his accommodation. It was getting dark.

Suddenly, a teenager came into view; he was gathering raspberries, 
cranberries, gooseberries. To Bray's relief — and astonishment — 
the teen was able to give him directions. In perfect English.

“How did you master English?” Bray asked him. 
“Oh, from watching cartoons on TV when I was young,” he answered.
